title: Sea Otters Eat 25% of Their Body Weight a Day. Here's Why
description:
A sea otter has no blubber, and cold water pulls heat from a body far faster than air. Here's the trick: the densest fur of any animal, up to a million hairs per square inch, traps a layer of air so its skin stays dry. And in 2021, scientists found its muscles burn energy just to make heat, which is why it eats about 25% of its body weight every day.
